phase9.question: Can authored-content validation move from module load to build/tests?

validationCostNode.note: vitest import timings include module transform; upper bounds

caseReadyBaseline.method: Cold /case/m02 until data-readiness=ready; 10 fresh browsers; 390x844; 4 Mbps/100 ms/4x CPU; vite preview

phase9.identityCheck: validatePackage(raw) serialises differently from the raw JSON for M02, so parsing is not an identity transform. Expansion fixture hashes are computed from the parsed package; skipping validation at load would change hashes and break existing saves.
phase9.decision: Keep validation at module load. No variant was shipped or measured further because the compatibility risk is disqualifying.

phase10.question: Can a back/forward-cached page keep a mission Web Lock?
phase10.method: Chromium 1243 via Playwright against vite preview: page A opens /case/m02 until ready; page B in the same context queries navigator.locks; A navigates away, then back.
phase10.backNavigation: type back_forward; readiness busy then normal inspection (page reloaded, not restored with prior state)
phase10.decision: No release/re-acquire handling added: Chromium did not keep the lock. Firefox/WebKit not tested here (not installed); physical Safari remains untested.
